summary: Valion Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, reporting a Third Side Letter under its April 29, 2025 Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement with 3i, LP, as assigned and amended December 9, 2025. 3i agreed to purchase 50 Series B Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Shares and Series B Warrants for 1,539 common shares at a $2.5520 exercise price, for $50,000 aggregate, subject to closing conditions. Securities were issued under Section 4(a)(2) and/or Rule 506(b) exemptions. This is a routine private placement drawdown under an existing facility, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor was named.
